Migration complete and verified. No stale Pages Router APIs remain anywhere in the codebase.

## Summary

Migrated every route from the Pages Router to the App Router and deleted the `pages/` directory. I followed the version-matched docs in `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` (the App Router migration guide, Next 16 upgrade notes, and the `route`/`page`/`layout`/`not-found`/`error`/`generateStaticParams` references) since AGENTS.md warns this Next 16 canary has breaking changes.

### What was migrated

| Pages Router | App Router | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `pages/_app.js` + `pages/_document.js` | `app/layout.tsx` | Root layout with `<html>/<body>`, `next/font` Inter (replaces Google Fonts `<link>`s), `metadata` (replaces `next/head`), AppProvider + header/nav/footer |
| `pages/index.js` (`getServerSideProps`) | `app/page.tsx` | Async Server Component; `fetch(..., { cache: 'no-store' })`; `headers()` for user-agent (async, Next 16); `useRouter`/`<a>` → `next/link` |
| `pages/404.js` | `app/not-found.tsx` | `metadata` replaces `next/head`; `useRouter().push` → `<Link>` |
| `pages/_error.js` | `app/error.tsx` | Client error boundary with `{ error, retry }` (the new App Router error API) |
| `pages/blog/index.js` (`getStaticProps` + `revalidate:60`) | `app/blog/page.tsx` | `fetch(..., { next: { revalidate: 60 } })` (ISR) |
| `pages/blog/[id].js` (`getStaticPaths`/`getStaticProps`/`fallback:'blocking'`) | `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` | `generateStaticParams`; `fetch` with `revalidate:300`; `notFound()` on error; `generateMetadata` for per-post `next/head`; `router.back()` moved to a client `back-button.tsx` using `useRouter` from `next/navigation` |
| `pages/api/posts/index.js` | `app/api/posts/route.ts` | Route Handler `GET`/`POST` via Web `Request`/`Response.json` |
| `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` | `GET`/`PUT`/`DELETE`; `params` is now a `Promise` (awaited) |

### Key API replacements
- `next/head` → `metadata` / `generateMetadata` exports
- `next/router` `useRouter` → `next/link` `Link` (and `next/navigation` `useRouter` in the client back button)
- `getServerSideProps` → Server Component + `cache: 'no-store'` + `headers()`
- `getStaticProps` + `revalidate` → `fetch` with `next: { revalidate }`
- `getStaticPaths` + `fallback` → `generateStaticParams` + default `dynamicParams: true`
- `req.headers`/`req.query`/`req.body`/`res.json` → Web `headers()`, `request.nextUrl.searchParams`, `await request.json()`, `Response.json`
- `next/document` `<Html>/<Head>` → root `layout.tsx` + `next/font`

### Types
Added TypeScript throughout: new `lib/types.ts` (`JsonPlaceholderPost`, `JsonPlaceholderComment`, `ApiPost`), typed `AppProvider.tsx` (replacing the untyped `.js`), typed `params: Promise<...>` on pages/routes, `Metadata` exports, and `NextRequest`/`Response` on route handlers.

### Verification
- `npx tsc --noEmit` → passes (exit 0)
- `npx next build` → succeeds; route table matches original behavior: `/` dynamic (ƒ, was SSR), `/blog` static with 1m revalidate (ISR), `/blog/[id]` SSG with 10 prerendered paths + 5m revalidate, `/api/posts*` dynamic
- Runtime smoke test (`next start`): `GET /api/posts` 200, valid `POST` 201, bad `POST` 400, `GET/PUT/DELETE /api/posts/5` 200, undefined `PATCH` 405 (auto `Allow`), `/` 200, `/blog/1` title rendered via metadata template, unmatched URL 404

Note: `package.json` and `tsconfig.json` show as modified in git — `package.json`'s `next` version pin/devDeps reordering was pre-existing dirty-worktree state (not touched by me); `tsconfig.json` was reconfigured by `next build` to add `.next/dev/types/**/*.ts` (Next-managed). The `.next/` build output is untracked.
